articles.title: A Neighbor Planet Just Got Way More Exciting!
articles.summary: Scientists thought planet GJ 3378b was too big and squishy for life. New measurements show it's only 2.3 times Earth's mass — rocky and cozy. It's just 25 light-years away, practically next door!

articles.title: Minions Crash the Box Office with Monster-Sized Laughs!
articles.summary: The new Minions movie scared up $16 million on Friday, grabbing the #1 spot. It's set in the 1920s, where the yellow troublemakers try to make a monster movie. Toy Story 5 is still going strong in second place.

articles.title: Two Classic Games Become Best Friends Thanks to Mods!
articles.summary: Modders are blending 'The Elder Scrolls 3: Morrowind' with 'Final Fantasy 11.' Two mods change the game's menus and cursor to look like the classic MMO. Both games came out in 2002 and share a love for slow, careful exploration.
